name: @untch/escalation
description: Untch escalation service (PRD §7.2 / §27). Channel-agnostic escalation lifecycle for the operator-approval path: the deterministic policy engine escalates a decision, this service fans it out to a control channel (Telegram now, Photon later), and resolves the operator's response through the FULL §27 authority-boundary check before it counts. Channels never make money decisions — they only transport a response the engine already asked for. Timeout → default DENY (I2, fail closed). Wires x402-guard's poll() to resolve against real escalations.
